notes.title: 8/15 Patch & Maintenance Notice
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, this is the PUBG: BLINDSPOT development team.  [/p][p]We will be conducting a patch and maintenance to improve the game and resolve issues.  [/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]Maintenance Schedule[/h3][list][*][p] August 15th (Fri.) 10:00 AM ~ 11:00 AM KST (1 hour)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixed Issues[/h3][list][*][p] Fixed an issue where some tactical tools were unintentionally blocking explosion damage.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where characters would not spawn in certain situations on some maps.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed duplicate icons used for some weapons.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
Important Notice[/h3][p]
Game access will be unavailable during the maintenance period. Please restart your Steam app after maintenance is completed to apply the update.

Thank you for your understanding regarding this maintenance for a better gaming environment.


Thank you.
[/p]
